item.title: Contact us
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Contact us

HomePage

Address

69 2nd Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11215, USA

Monday – Tuesday 10.00am – 4.00pm (By Appointment Only)
Wednesday – Saturday, 10.00am – 4.00pm
Sunday, Closed

Phone

(211) 820-8293

Email

info@woodmart.com

Get In Touch

    Frequently Asked Questions

    My order hasn't arrived yet. Where is it?

    Keep the product in its original packaging along with all documents confirming the purchase and refund. You will need this for further communication with the seller and the payment system.

    Do you deliver on public holidays?

    Check the email you received after placing your order. It should contain information about the status of your order and the expected delivery date.

    Do you deliver to my postcode?

    Track the status of your order:a Woodmart marketplace provides the ability to track the status of an order by tracking number.

    Is next-day delivery available on all orders?

    Keep the product in its original packaging along with all documents confirming the purchase and refund. You will need this for further communication with the seller and the payment system.

    Do I need to be there to sign for delivery?

    Check the email you received after placing your order. It should contain information about the status of your order and the expected delivery date.
